description: Source code for the TurretComponent class, managing turret aiming, targeting, and orientation logic in a game.

classes.name: TurretComponent
classes.description: Component class managing turret targeting, aiming, and orientation in a game environment.

methods.name: TurretComponent
methods.description: Constructor initializing turret with entity reference, setting base direction and resetting aim.

methods.name: ~TurretComponent
methods.description: Destructor ensuring target removal and cleanup.

methods.name: HandlePrepareNetCode
methods.description: Prepares network code, copying aim angles to entity state.

methods.name: SetRange
methods.description: Sets the targeting range of the turret.

methods.name: GetTarget
methods.description: Returns current target entity if valid.

methods.name: RemoveTarget
methods.description: Removes current target and resets line of sight timer.

methods.name: TargetValid
methods.description: Checks if current target is valid based on game conditions.

methods.name: FindEntityTarget
methods.description: Finds and assigns the best target based on comparison criteria.

methods.name: MoveHeadToTarget
methods.description: Adjusts turret aim towards target within angle speed limits.

methods.name: GetAimAngles
methods.description: Returns current aim angles in absolute form.

methods.name: TrackEntityTarget
methods.description: Updates direction vector to follow moving target.

methods.name: ResetDirection
methods.description: Resets aim direction to base direction.

methods.name: ResetPitch
methods.description: Resets pitch angle to zero.

methods.name: LowerPitch
methods.description: Lowers pitch angle to PITCH_CAP.

methods.name: TargetCanBeHit
methods.description: Performs line trace to check if target can be hit.

methods.name: SetBaseDirection
methods.description: Sets initial base direction based on obstacle detection.

methods.name: TorsoAngles
methods.description: Returns the current torso angles of the entity.

methods.name: RelativeAnglesToAbsoluteAngles
methods.description: Converts relative aim angles to absolute world angles.

methods.name: AbsoluteAnglesToRelativeAngles
methods.description: Converts absolute world angles to relative aim angles.

methods.name: DirectionToAbsoluteAngles
methods.description: Converts a direction vector to absolute angles.

methods.name: DirectionToRelativeAngles
methods.description: Converts a direction vector to relative angles.

methods.name: AbsoluteAnglesToDirection
methods.description: Converts absolute angles to a direction vector.

methods.name: RelativeAnglesToDirection
methods.description: Converts relative angles to a direction vector.
